name: Tema
overview: Tema is a male figure identified as the ninth-born son of Ishmael, belonging to the tribe named after him. His lineage places him within the broader narrative of Ishmael's descendants. There are no additional notes providing further details about his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Tema means 'on the right [not left] side, hence south country,' reflecting a geographical or positional significance rather than a divine naming. This proper name is recorded in Genesis 25:15.
familyAndRelationships: Tema is explicitly recorded as a son of Ishmael, establishing his place within Ishmael's family line. Scripture does not provide further family relationships beyond this direct filial connection.
scriptureSignificance: Tema's significance lies in his role as a son of Ishmael, who is a key patriarchal figure in the biblical narrative. As the ninth son, Tema represents one of the tribes descending from Ishmael, contributing to the broader understanding of Ishmael's lineage and the peoples that arose from it. His mention helps to trace the genealogical and tribal identities important in biblical history.
